notes.title: Steam page Error - Lux to release in December!
notes.content:
Hello all!

I made some mistakes in setting up the Lux page. I wasn't able to figure out how to put out the demo without releasing the game (whoops). 
Because of this, please note that both versions are the same demo! We will put this on the title screen soon to let you know. 

So please look forward to a full release of Lux this December.
